{{Quote|All right, listen up! Maintain squad formations. 'A' Squad, you're on me&mdash;|Commander Cody, at the Battle of Sarrish|<ref name="Routine Valor" />}}
'''"A" Squad''' was a [[Clone trooper/Legends|clone trooper]] [[Squad/Legends|unit]] within the [[Grand Army of the Republic/Legends|Grand Army of the Republic's]] [[212th Attack Battalion/Legends|212th Attack Battalion]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]. Led by a [[Cloning/Legends|clone]] [[Unidentified clone trooper lieutenant (Sarrish)|lieutenant]], it fell under the overall command of [[Clone Marshal Commander/Legends|Marshal Commander]] [[Cody/Legends|CC-2224]] in the [[Battle of Sarrish/Legends|Battle of Sarrish]], which took place in [[20 BBY/Legends|20 BBY]]. After crashing their [[Low Altitude Assault Transport/infantry/Legends|LAAT/i]] [[Shuttle/Legends|shuttle]] during the battle, the squad moved to eliminate an [[anti-aircraft gun]]. At least eight members of the squad were [[Death/Legends|killed]], while two others were injured. Despite their losses, "A" Squad successfully defeated the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Separatist]] forces&mdash;completing their mission&mdash;with a small group led by Cody destroying the anti-aircraft gun.

==Description==
The [[Grand Army of the Republic/Legends|Grand Army of the Republic's]] "A" Squad served under [[Jedi General/Legends|Jedi General]] [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi's]] [[212th Attack Battalion/Legends|212th Attack Battalion]]. The unit operated at least one [[Low Altitude Assault Transport/infantry/Legends|LAAT/i]] [[Gunship/Legends|gunship]] and was supplied with [[DC-15A blaster rifle/Legends|DC-15A blaster rifles]], [[DC-15S/Legends|DC-15S]] [[Blaster carbine/Legends|blaster carbines]], and [[Ascension cable/Legends|ascension cables]]. All [[Clone trooper/Legends|clone troopers]] in the [[Squad/Legends|squad]] wore [[Phase II clone trooper armor/Legends|Phase II clone trooper armor]] with [[Color/Legends|orange]] markings.<ref name="Routine Valor" />

==History==
===A routine mission===
{{Quote|What's our status, lieutenant?''"<br />"''Two injured, four dead. Five, if you count the pilot.|Cody and the lieutenant recount their losses during the Battle of Sarrish|<ref name="Routine Valor" />}}
[[File:CodyBrief.png|thumb|left|300px|Commander Cody prepares to brief "A" Squad before they land.]]
"A" Squad was deployed&mdash;alongside the rest of the 212th Attack Battalion&mdash;to the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Sarrish/Legends|Sarrish]] of the [[Vensensor sector/Legends|Vensensor sector]] in the [[Battle of Sarrish/Legends|Battle of Sarrish]]<ref name="Routine Valor" /> in [[20 BBY/Legends|20 BBY]]<ref name="Sarrish date" /> as part of the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]. On the planet, the [[Cloning/Legends|clone]] forces were ordered by Kenobi&mdash;mid-flight via LAAT/i gunships&mdash;to shatter the front lines of the opposing [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Separatist]] forces and eliminate any remaining pockets of resistance. They were also ordered to avoid the [[anti-aircraft gun]] on the mountaintops and to leave it for the gunships and [[Aggressive ReConnaissance-170 starfighter/Legends|ARC-170]] [[starfighter]]s. After giving [[Clone Marshal Commander/Legends|Marshal Commander]] [[Cody/Legends|CC-2224]], nicknamed "Cody," and the rest of the 212th their objective, Kenobi departed.<ref name="Routine Valor" />

While thirty [[Standard second|seconds]] away from the landing zone, Cody began to explain the plan to "A" Squad, but the LAAT/i they were aboard was hit by heavy [[Flak/Legends|flak]] and crashed. Two members of the squad were injured, while five others&mdash;including the [[Clone trooper pilot/Legends|clone pilot]]&mdash;were [[Death/Legends|killed]]. The crash landed the squad precisely near the anti-aircraft gun. Thinking quickly and as they believed Kenobi would, Cody and the squad's [[Unidentified clone trooper lieutenant (Sarrish)|lieutenant]] ordered the troops to prepare for battle, all while taking cover behind their downed [[Shuttle/Legends|shuttle]]. [[Trooper/Legends|Troopers]] [[Eight-eight-six-seven]], [[Eight-eight-six-eight]], and [[Eight-eight-six-nine]] were then ordered by Cody to affix grapples to their DC-15A [[Blaster/Legends|blaster]] [[Rifle/Legends|rifles]] and follow him&mdash;their goal having changed to destroying the anti-aircraft gun&mdash;while the remainder would prepare for covering fire.<ref name="Routine Valor" />

===Fateful climb===
{{Quote|The fighting in my section was a bit heavier than expected. How was it where you were?''"<br />"''Routine. About what we expected.|Obi-Wan Kenobi and Cody speak during a calm moment at Sarrish|<ref name="Routine Valor" />}}
[[File:CodyAndTheGun-RV.jpg|thumb|right|300px|"A" Squad's ground forces helped eliminate the battle droid manning the anti-aircraft gun as it aimed for Commander Cody.]]
As Commander Cody, Eight-eight-six-seven, Eight-eight-six-eight, and Eight-eight-six-nine climbed towards the gun, the three troopers were killed. One was shot just as the group left the wreckage of the gunship, another fell to their death during the climb, and the last was shot in the head by a [[B1-series battle droid/Legends|B1-Series battle droid]]; as a result, Cody was the only survivor of the sub-group.<ref name="Routine Valor" />

After Cody reached the summit, he began to grapple with the [[Battle droid/Legends|battle droids]] present, taking out two of them. The forces on the ground eliminated the remaining battle [[Droid/Legends|droid]] piloting the gun just as it aimed at Cody, allowing him to take control of the gun and wipe out the remaining droid forces using it. Following their victory, the remaining troops of "A" Squad celebrated. In a later discussion with Kenobi, Cody described the skirmish as "routine" and in line with their expectations. Despite "A" Squad's small victory,<ref name="Routine Valor" /> the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Republic]] suffered a devastating loss with the Battle of Sarrish.<ref name="MIA">{{TCW|Missing in Action}}</ref>

==Commanders and crew==
{{Quote|General Kenobi ordered us not to try taking this section from the ground.''"<br />"''That's what he said. But what would the general do if he was here?|The lieutenant and Cody discuss their plan of action|<ref name="Routine Valor" />}}
"A" Squad was led by a clone lieutenant of the 212th Attack Battalion, who in turn served under Commander Cody, the Clone Marshal Commander of the 212th Attack Battalion. While [[General/Legends|General]] Kenobi did not directly lead "A" Squad, the orders under which they served came from his command. "A" Squad consisted of at least eleven other clone troopers, including a [[Pilot/Legends|pilot]], Eight-eight-six-seven, Eight-eight-six-eight, and Eight-eight-six-nine.<ref name="Routine Valor" />

==Behind the scenes==
"A" Squad was created by writer [[Randy Stradley]] for the [[Star Wars comic books|comic]] story ''[[Routine Valor]]'', which was illustrated by [[Douglas Wheatley]]<ref name="Routine Valor" /> and published by [[Dark Horse Comics]] on [[May 6]], [[2006]] for [[Wikipedia:Free Comic Book Day|Free Comic Book Day]].<ref name="FreeComic">{{DarkHorse|url=Comics/13-848/Free-Comic-Book-Day-2006-Star-Wars-Conan-Split-Issue|text=FREE COMIC BOOK DAY 2006 STAR WARS/CONAN SPLIT ISSUE}}</ref>
